This example combines covariance matrices with declared regressor norms. The
result is descriptive: adaptive HRF selection and its uncertainty need separate
qualification, and the weights are not interaction-model evidence.

```{r}
library(multiPPI)
D1 <- matrix(c(0, 1, 1, 0), 2)
D2 <- matrix(c(0, .2, .2, 0), 2)
result <- mppi_hrf_adapt(list(D1, D2), pk_norms = c(1, .3))
result$weights
result$Delta
```
